notes: POC scope: customer cares most about 'deflect at first contact' — need high precision in top-1 and stable top-5 quality for automated agent handoffs.
Indexing expectations: ~6M canonical support documents + 18M passage-level chunks after split; expect steady-state ingest 10k docs/day during peak.
Query profile: 120k queries/day (peak 250 qps), 80% short-chatstyle queries, 20% long-context searches that require reranking.
Latency SLOs: target P95 end-to-end (embed search + cross-encoder top-5 rerank) <= 200ms for <=512 token queries; soft target P99 <= 350ms.
Cost sensitivity: procurement target cost-per-deflection (avg query) <$0.005 — we need to provide cost scenarios (hosted vs dedicated + quantization).

Model preferences: prefer open-source embeddings (sentence-transformers) and a lightweight cross-encoder for rerank (willing to test distilled cross-encoders or 3B variants). No blackbox-only endpoints.

Routing/fallback: primary path is dense recall + hybrid lexical; fallback to bi-encoder only (no rerank) when dedicated cluster overloaded. Also want region-aware routing (NA primary, EU for specific customers).
Security: mandatory SSO/SAML, customer KMS for keys, audit logs for query access, configurable retention (30–365 days), and data residency in US + Canada for specific segments.
Quote from VP Product on 2026-02-28 call: 'We need top-5 precision to be rock solid — if the reranker slips we lose trust in auto-deflection.'
Current stack: ElasticSearch for longtail metadata, Pinecone proof-of-concept for vector recall (customer evaluating move to integrated platform with reranker).
Requested deliverables: end-to-end perf report (P50/P95/P99), cost-per-query calc for 3 sizing options, suggested quantization + batching config, and failover policy doc.
requirements_summary: Embeddings + reranking RAG for support-agent use case. Index scale ~6M docs (18M passages). Throughput ~250 qps peak. P95 end-to-end latency <=200ms for top-5 rerank. Cost target <$0.005/query. Needs VPC or dedicated env with SSO/KMS/audit logs and US/CA residency. Prefer open models and ability to tune reranker. Fallback to bi-encoder-only when under pressure.
sales_notes: AE strategy: push a two-phase deal — short Dedicated POC (4 weeks) to hit latency and cost targets, then annual reserved capacity.
Upsell path: Redwood Optimize (quantization + batching recommendations) + extended observability retention for 12 months.
